QuestInfo.name: [Daily Quest] Esfera Research Orders
QuestInfo.0:
#bEsfera, the Origin Sea#k is located at the end of the Arcane River. While you're there, #bOllie#k at the #rBase Camp#k can give you the daily quest to complete.

It's as good a time as any to help the Alliance carry out research in Esfera.
